items.title: CHC50125 Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care
items.description: Quality Diploma of Early Childhood Education Courses. Government Funding available. Face-to-face & virtual/online classes commencing soon.
highlighted: Quality Diploma of Early Childhood Education Courses

items.markdown:
A Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care (CHC50125 / CHC50121) `qualifies you to become a Lead Educator, Room Leader, or Service Director in childcares and kindergartens` . The course typically takes 12 months, and in Victoria, it is heavily subsidized or offered under the **Free TAFE** initiative for eligible students.[](https://www.holmesglen.edu.au/explore-courses/english-education-and-teacher-training/early-childhood-education/vocational-education/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care) [[1]](https://www.holmesglen.edu.au/explore-courses/english-education-and-teacher-training/early-childhood-education/vocational-education/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care)[[2]](https://www.swinburne.edu.au/course/tafe/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)[[3]](https://www.vic.gov.au/you-can-shape-young-lives)[[4]](https://www.scu.edu.au/study/courses/graduate-diploma-in-education-early-childhood-1107425/)[[5]](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/education/early-childhood-education/)

Top Providers in Melbourne

- **Melbourne Polytechnic:** Offers Free TAFE and traineeship options at campuses like Preston and Epping. Learn more via the [Melbourne Polytechnic Early Childhood Education Courses](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/education/early-childhood-education/) page.[](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/education/early-childhood-education/) [[1]](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/education/early-childhood-education/)[[2]](https://www.melbournepolytechnic.edu.au/study/diploma/early-childhood-education-and-care/non-traineeship/)
- **Box Hill Institute:** Offers flexible study formats, including online delivery for students currently working in the sector. Explore their structure on the [Box Hill Institute Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-edec5-d/) page.[](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-edec5-d/) [[1]](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-edec5-d/)[[2]](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/campuses/online-learning)[[3]](https://applyzones.com/boxhill-institute-lakeside-campus-sch49)
- **Holmesglen:** Provides a comprehensive pathway with strong practical placements across the city. View course details on the [Holmesglen Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care](https://www.holmesglen.edu.au/explore-courses/english-education-and-teacher-training/early-childhood-education/vocational-education/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care) course page.[](https://www.holmesglen.edu.au/explore-courses/english-education-and-teacher-training/early-childhood-education/vocational-education/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care) [[1]](https://www.holmesglen.edu.au/explore-courses/english-education-and-teacher-training/early-childhood-education/vocational-education/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care)
- **Victoria University:** Features play-based learning and five mandatory work placements. Details are available on the [Victoria University Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care](https://www.vu.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-chc50125) page.[](https://www.vu.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-chc50125) [[1]](https://www.vu.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-chc50125)

Entry Requirements To enrol in the Diploma, you generally need to hold a **Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care** . Alternatively, experienced unqualified workers may be able to enter via an approved entry skill set or prior industry experience. You will also need a valid Working With Children Check (WWCC).[](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-edec5-d/) [[1]](https://www.boxhill.edu.au/courses/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-edec5-d/)[[2]](https://www.swinburne.edu.au/course/tafe/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care/)[[3]](https://training.gov.au/training/details/CHC50121)[[4]](https://sj.vic.edu.au/course/diploma-of-early-childhood-education-and-care-chc50121/)[[5]](https://www.axiomcollege.com.au/how-to-become-a-childcare-worker-in-australia-the-2026-career-guide/)Career and Financial Benefits

- **Salary Expectations:** Diploma-qualified educators typically earn between $28 and $35 per hour (or $55,000 to $65,000 annually).
- **Scholarships:** The Victorian Government provides financial support of up to $7,000 for educators upskilling to a diploma. Details on eligibility and funding can be found at the [vic.gov.au Early Childhood Scholarships Program](https://www.vic.gov.au/you-can-shape-young-lives).[[1]](https://enablecollege.edu.au/how-much-can-you-earn-as-a-childcare-educator-in-australia)[[2]](https://www.vic.gov.au/you-can-shape-young-lives)[[3]](https://www.federation.edu.au/about/news/media-release/earn-while-you-learn-in-early-childhood-education/)
